subject: Child Development & Pedagogy
stem: A school counsellor conducts a single session with an entire class on 'effective study habits and time management', addressing all students together rather than individually. This form of guidance is called:
explanation: Group guidance addresses common needs shared by many students simultaneously, while individual guidance addresses a specific student's unique concerns one-on-one.

subject: Child Development & Pedagogy
stem: Guidance services in schools are traditionally classified into three broad types. Which of the following correctly lists all three?
explanation: The classic three-fold classification of school guidance is Educational (academic decisions), Vocational (career choices), and Personal/Personal-Social (emotional and social adjustment).
